intelligence.human_view: Think of a workshop that finally learned to count honestly. The count is good bricks laid per minute, not hours spent looking busy, and the tower still has to be beautiful — so the checker and the eye are not overhead to be cut when the number looks low; they are the reason the tower stands. The first move is to clear the bench: finish filing the work already made, answer it the same hour, stop standing around waiting for a verdict. Then put the new door on the house instead of leaving it in the workshop, and walk through the whole house yourself, opening every door, pressing every button. The light is the same discipline at hover depth: light lives underneath the object, behind it, around it — never smeared across its face, or the object stops being an object. The parts are the same discipline at build depth: take the glowing set, the real digit tiles, the good build, exactly as they are, because a copy made from looking is always a little worse. Every thing has its place — points on the Dashboard and the profile, the time and date alone at the top — and a page that was once beautiful all on one screen is restored, not re-imagined. That is the whole system in one habit: count what is real, finish what is started, put it live, walk it, and keep it beautiful.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a team building a tower. Shawn asks how many good bricks land in the tower each minute. Right now it is 14 in every 100. He wants 50 first, then more. We get there by finishing work we already made. We stop standing around waiting. We never skip checking the bricks to go faster. The icons must glow from underneath, not over the top. All pages share the same glowing icons. Numbers are just a little bigger, and they are the real ones. Each board lights up in its own color as you scroll. Every thing lives where it belongs. And we only call it done when it is live and we have walked through it.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, Shawn asks how much good work we really finish every minute, dear — right now 14 in a hundred, and 50 is the floor he can live with on the way up. The way there, dear, is simple: finish filing the work that is already done, get the answer the same hour, and stop standing around waiting. But the checking stays, dear — done right is the whole point. Then put the new front page live where everyone can see it, dear, and walk the whole way through yourself, pressing every button, fixing anything that does not go to the right place. The icons glow from underneath, dear, like the best ones already do, and every thing lives where it belongs — points on the Dashboard, the time and date alone at the top, each board lighting up in its own color as you scroll. And if a page was once beautiful all on one screen, dear, put back what was good, exactly as it was.
intelligence.naya_view: COUNT VALUABLE VERIFIABLE USABLE OUTPUTS PER MINUTE AND HOUR, TEAM SIZE NAMED, TOKEN SPEND BESIDE IT IN NUMBERS. FILE THE BACKLOG FIRST; VERDICTS THE SAME HOUR; STOP THE WAITING. THE CHECKER AND THE EYE STAY — THE NUMBER NEVER BUYS ITS WAY PAST THE QUALITY. PUT THE FRONT PAGE LIVE ON THE MAIN DOMAIN; UPDATE THE HUB WITH TODAY'S HUB; TEST THE FLOW END TO END — EVERY BUTTON TO THE RIGHT PLACE, ANYTHING THAT DOES NOT WORK NOTED, FIXED, MADE RIGHT — AND VERIFY A DEPLOY ONLY BY A FRESH FETCH OF NAYANET.APP. UNDERGLOW EVERYWHERE: THE COLOR GLOWS UNDERNEATH THE ICON, NEVER OVER IT. NO FLAT BOARDS, NO FOLDED TEXT — ICONS SPEAK. ONE ICON SET EVERYWHERE, THE GLOWING PERSONAL SET HARVESTED VERBATIM. CALENDAR NUMBERS EXACTLY 20% BIGGER THAN THE ORIGINAL, THE REAL DASHBOARD DIGIT TILES, MIDDLE, BLACK AREA, PERFECTLY SPACED, LINED UP. SCROLL LIGHT: EACH BOARD ITS OWN COLOR AS YOU GO DOWN — SEE SEPARATION AND FEEL SEPARATION. SIDEBAR ORBS AROUND EACH ICON; ONE MENU THING, MAYBE ONE ON EITHER SIDE; HUB TOP JUST THE TIME AND DATE, CLEAN. POINTS IN THE DASHBOARD AND ON THE PROFILE, NEVER IN THE HUB. RESTORE WHAT WAS GOOD, BYTE FOR BYTE, ALL ON ONE SCREEN — NEVER ITERATE ON THE BROKEN ONE. CLAIM NOTHING UNTIL THE EYE REPORTS.
